what: The zhol business plan as a PDF in the style of the TEF pitch deck (owner, 27 Nov 2026: «это все должно быть в PDF формате, еще в стиле презентации питча»). 23 pages of 1920x1080, Inter, the pitch deck colours (deck.css). Text source: the Claude Docs business plan https://claude.ai/artifact/XLk1YGkmD8Bb2YrKakXgdk. Output: docs/zhol-business-plan-2026-11.pdf. Build: python3 build.py, then node render.js bizplan.html out.pdf [shots-dir].
